name: Dolly zoom
description: The 'Vertigo' move: the speaker stays the same size while the room behind them grows, as if the camera dollied back while the lens zoomed in. Then it snaps back.
when: On a realisation or a shock: 'and then it hit me'.
needs: the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
a clean plate: the room without the speaker (plate.png)
